subject: BrightHealth: short customer video & logistics
messages:
From: Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@brighthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-10 14:05:12 -0400
Subject: BrightHealth: short customer video & logistics

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for a great call today — the team at BrightHealth is excited to move forward with a brief customer video to feature the latency and cost improvements we saw after migrating key inference workloads to Redwood. We envision a 2–3 minute piece focusing on:
- What we used to do (very high-level)
- Measurable benefits (latency reduction, cost per request)
- The product/people impact (faster iteration, fewer timeouts)

We have a small onsite studio at our Boston HQ and can host a shoot. Current dates that work for us are April 22 or 23. Ideally we’d keep it to half a day.

Could you share:
1) A short script / talking points for the customer (so our execs can review)
2) A run-of-show and estimated crew time
3) The release form / legal language (we’ll loop legal if needed)

Appreciate your help coordinating — copying Jorge (legal) and our internal comms lead for visibility.

Best,
Amelia Rios
Director, Customer Success
BrightHealth

--

1) Script / talking points: Marissa (marketing) will draft a short script and three topline talking points for executive review.
2) Run-of-show & crew time: see details below (high level estimate).
3) Release: attaching our standard testimonial release (draft) for Jorge to review and redline.

Proposed high-level run-of-show (half-day onsite):
- 09:30 crew arrival / equipment setup / tech check
- 10:00 talent arrives / makeup & mics (15–20 min)
- 10:30 on-camera interviews (primary exec: ~20 min, secondary: 10–15 min)
- 11:20 B-roll around engineering floor (10–20 min)
- 11:50 wrap + quick playback review

Crew: producer (Monica), 1 camera operator, sound tech (Monica can confirm crew list). We plan for a 3–4 person crew total.

Travel & logistics: Redwood covers travel for crew; if BrightHealth prefers to reimburse travel directly we can accommodate.

Please confirm: preferred date (22 vs 23), on-site contact, and whether we should avoid any product/pricing figures in the footage (we can script around that).

On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 5:20 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Amelia — excited to do this. Quick responses inline and next steps below.
>
> 1) Script / talking points: Marissa (marketing) will draft a short script and three topline talking points for executive review.

Hi all — first pass script and talking points attached. I kept language tight to make it easy for execs to memorize; this is for a 2–3 minute edit. Please review and flag any "do not mention" items (pricing, internal roadmap items, etc.).

Script (candidate — final will be shorter):
- Intro (3–5s): "I’m Amelia Rios, Director of Customer Success at BrightHealth."
- Challenge (15s): "Before Redwood, our inference pipeline experienced unpredictable latency at peak traffic which slowed downstream workflows..."
- Solution (30s): "We migrated key models to Redwood Inference. Within weeks we saw X% latency reduction and Y% fewer timeouts, which enabled faster releases and better member experience."
- Impact (20s): "Engineering can ship experiments faster; product dashboards reflect more stable performance."
- Close (10s): "Redwood gave us the predictability we needed to scale inference without breaking the bank."

Talking points (three quick bullets for execs to use):
- Focus on business impact (member experience, release cadence), not implementation details.
- Use concrete metric statements but avoid exact pricing or contract terms.
- Keep it human — short anecdotes about cross-team improvements work well.

B-roll & shots: lobby, collaboration by engineering desks, close-ups of dashboards (non-sensitive screenshots), walk-and-talk shots with Amelia.

Attachment: run_of_show_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference

We’re happy to grant use for product performance statements and marketing materials but need that pricing/contract exclusion. I attached our redline (brighthealth_release_redline.docx).

Also, April 23 works better for us — can we lock that date? Prefer a 10:00–12:30 window so we can handle internal prep beforehand.

Please confirm crew size and arrival time so I can arrange building access.

Regards,
Jorge Lopez
